title: Municipal District, Land Deals, Key Appointments
summary:
*   City leaders engaged in a discussion regarding the Randy Morine Municipal District.
*   The Council held a closed-door executive session to discuss potential land acquisitions, ongoing legal disputes, and personnel decisions.
*   Considered appointments to various city boards and commissions.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
absence of Councilmembers Urdy and Rose.
Mayor Cooksey announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a discussion of the Randy
Morine Municipal
District. Council did discuss.
Mayor Cooksey announced Council would enter into executive session pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss matters of land acquisition,
litigation and for personnel matters.
No official action of the City Council will be taken on any of these matters unless such
item is specifically listed on the agenda.
